title: Screenshot crop (real app screen only)
what_it_does: Crops a store screenshot to the real app screen by removing the caption band, margins and device frame, optionally also the iOS status bar.
when_to_use: Whenever a video uses an App Store or marketing screenshot: video may show only the real UI, never the caption or the phone frame.
notes: The source url is a placeholder (OWNER) until the repository is published. Builtin: a command of this CLI; add only records it in the studio.
